articles.title: Mitutoyo Digital Vernier Calipers
articles.body:
Mitutoyo Digital Vernier Calipers

No one can deny the fundamental necessity of precision measurement. Why? Because precise measurements ensure structural integrity and protection. Without precise measurements, errors can lead to misaligned structures, weakness, and failure. Regulations set by regulatory authorities and governing bodies are meant to reduce these errors and prevent potential safety and legal issues. Accordingly, calipers are meant to provide precise measurements in several industrial applications.

Why Use Precision Vernier Calipers

Accuracy is key in different industry applications, and therefore highly accurate calipers must be used to achieve accurate measurements. Industries such as construction, manufacturing, medical and automotive need these precision vernier calipers for precise machining and quality control. Precision vernier calipers are used to get the least deviated outside dimensions, inside dimensions, and depths. An indispensable tool built to provide accuracy, efficiency, and quality.

Modern industry applications use accurate calipers to reduce the tiniest possible variation in measurements to meet quality standards and legal obligations. Quality standards strictly prohibit deviations in many industrial projects. Take an example of factories that manufacture electronic parts, calipers ensure each circuit board and microchip is aligned together correctly and functions as required.

Mitutoyo Vernier Calipers for Every Need

Mitutoyo is highly regarded amongst precision measuring equipment for smooth operations, digital indicators, clear dials, durability, reliability, variety, and the use of advanced technology. Their calipers are used in a wide range of operations in several industries, across the world.

Mitutoyo produces a broad and diverse range of calipers in multiple variations, including digimatic calipers or digital Vernier Calipers, Vernier Calipers, Dial Calipers, and accessories. Absolute digimatic calipers product variations range from 0-1000mm / 0-40”, and are sold in Sri Lanka by the agent Unicorn Metalics. The most common industry application is the 0-150mm / 0-6” caliper, Mitutoyo Absolute Digimatic 150mm, which delivers the best in accuracy and speed, for repeatable measurements.

Mitutoyo designs and constructs their instruments with high-quality materials, accurate machining, and easy-to-read scales. The significance of these calipers is that the patented Absolute (ABS) sensor retains the origin point and eliminates constant zeroing, reducing error chances and improving efficient accuracy.

They represent the biggest and most prestigious brands around the globe, including large industries and corporates. articles.title: What are MDF, HDF, and HMR Boards?
articles.body:
When selecting engineered wood products, it’s essential to understand the differences between MDF (Medium Density Fibreboard), HDF (High Density Fibreboard), and HMR (High Moisture Resistant) boards. Each type offers distinct properties, making them suitable for various applications in Sri Lanka’s construction and furniture industries.

MDF (Medium Density Fibreboard)

MDF is an affordable and versatile wood composite made from wood fibres bonded with resin and heat. It has a smooth surface, making it ideal for furniture, cabinetry, and interior décor. In Sri Lanka, MDF is widely used for wardrobes, wall panels, and decorative elements, especially in residential and commercial spaces.

HDF (High Density Fibreboard)

HDF is a denser version of MDF, providing greater strength and durability. It is commonly used for flooring, doors, and high-traffic furniture. In Sri Lanka, HDF is particularly popular for laminate flooring and high-end furniture manufacturing, where durability is a key factor.

HMR (High Moisture Resistant) Board

HMR boards are engineered to resist moisture, making them perfect for kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and humid environments. Given Sri Lanka’s tropical climate, HMR boards are widely used in coastal areas and regions with high humidity, ensuring longevity in challenging conditions.

For high-quality MDF, HDF, and HMR boards, visit Stockpile.lk, Sri Lanka’s trusted B2B marketplace for construction, to connect with leading suppliers and ensure the best materials for your projects.

articles.title: Choosing A Waste Water Treatment Plant in Sri Lanka
articles.body:
If you're looking for methods to treat waste water in Sri Lanka such as sewage or manufacturing discharged water for the purpose of recycling or discharging it ethically and legally, then this article will attempt to shed some light on the procedure. 

What is Waste Water?

Waste water is any form of water that has been contaminated by some artificial process. The dictionary definition being water that has been used in the home, in a business, or as part of an industrial process. By this definition, waste water includes water from kitchens, bathroom showers, sinks, toilets, hotels, restaurants, and also industrial waste water discharged from manufacturing facilities such as textile factories, rubber manufacturing, bottle washing, food processing, etc. As a result, waste water treatment plants are also commonly referred to as sewage treatment plants and sewer treatment plants. It is illegal to discharge such water into any public stream, lake, water way or the ocean, as it can contain harmful chemicals or biological organisms that can negatively affect the ecosystem. 

What is Waste Water Treatment?

Simply put, waste water treatment is a process by which bacteria is used to consume the biological and chemical components in the water, which results in water with reduced Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) and a sludge that can be safely dissipated. The process would normally take a few days, but the methods in which the treatment plants handle the water can result in a continuous discharge of treated water. 

Where should Waste Water Treatment Plants Be Used?

Under Sri Lankan government regulations, if access to a sewage line is unavailable or not approved, then according to the Central Environment Authority (CEA) of Sri Lanka, any waste water that is being discharged into a public stream, lake, water way or ocean, should be tested and pass the required Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) numbers stipulated by them. Example:
  • Condominiums (apartments)
  • Hotels
  • Manufacturing & production facilities
  • Hospitals 
  • Restaurants
It is important to know the BOD requirement for your relevant application. The relevant gazette can be found on the CEA website's Acts & Regulations page under Industrial Effluent (Water) Quality Management. 

What Are The Types of Waste Water Treatment Plants?

Waste water treatment plants can be separated into many different categories based on the process, and the physical characteristics of the plants.Physically, the plant can be a modular design, where components can be assembled remotely and installed on the location within a short period of time. Alternatively, the plant's chambers can be constructed on-site with the mechanical components being installed afterwards; this method would require more time. Both methods have advantages and disadvantages. It is the condition and requirements of the site that would help determine which method of installation should be used. The process can vary between Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor (MBBR), Fixed Bed Biofilm Reactor (FBBR), and Sequencing Batch Reactor (SBR). MBBR and FBBR processes both continuously circulate the influent waste water through chambers that contain the bacteria and discharge treated water continuously. This design requires treatment chambers large enough to sufficiently dilute the intake waste water with the treated water so that it meets the BOD regulations. SBR treatment plants process the water in stages, and therefore the chambers should be large enough to hold the entire intake of waste water for the duration of the stage. 

Who Are Suppliers of Waste Water Treatment Plants in Sri Lanka?

In Sri Lanka there are numerous suppliers of all varieties of sewage treatment plants to meet your specifications and requirements, with ICC Smart Eco Solutions being one of them. They manufacture modular as well as on-site constructed MBBR and FBBR waste water treatment plants. View the product details and list of successfully completed projects on each of the product pages.

articles.title: Are TOR, TMT and QST Steel Bars the same?
articles.body:
When it comes to steel reinforcement, you may have heard people using many different words and acronyms to specify them. In this article we'll explain what each of those mean, and what they are suitable for. 

TOR

TOR steel is the generic term used to refer to reinforcement steel. It is actually a brand name of steel produced by Toristeg Steel Corporation of Luxembourg, or TOR for short. Because of the brand's popularity people still refer to regular cold twisted deformed bars as TOR steel, but this is incorrect use of the name. 

CTD

Cold Twisted Deformed is a high-strength steel bar which is twisted resulting in ribs and lugs on the surface. This texture on the surface enhances the grip that concrete has with the bar in comparison to a smooth bar, and prevents slippage. 

TMT

Thermo-Mechanically Treated bars undergo a process of quenching and tempering, which results in a tougher outer surface but retains a ductile inner core. The combination results in a high tensile strength with flexibility. 

QST

Quenched Self-Tempered is a process where the heated bar is rapidly cooled, then reheated and allowed to cool naturally  to create a fine-grained microstructure.  

TOR/CTD QST TMT
Strength Regular High Highest
Ductility Regular High High
Cost Regular High Highest

articles.title: Stockpile Goes Live
articles.body: On April 7th 2022 Stockpile made its services available to the public via its website STOCKPILE.LKIf interested in listing their products and services, suppliers of solutions, materials, tools and equipment for the construction industry can now register directly on the website, which is targeted specifically towards general contractors, architects and consultants engaged in the Sri Lankan construction industry. Once registered, suppliers will receive all Request for Quotations (RFQ)s relevant to their products and services that have been submitted by registered contractors. Potential buyers can browse and view product details, specifications, past projects and terms of sale of each supplier. Stockpile is a product of Construction Trade Technologies (Pvt) Ltd. and aims to eliminate the inefficiencies of material procurement in the Sri Lankan construction industry. By using the software procurement teams can request quotations, negotiate and submit purchase orders directly to the suppliers, thereby streamlining the entire procurement process.Click on How It Works to learn more about how Stockpile can work for both buyers and suppliers.

articles.title: Stockpile signs agreement with YCF
articles.body:
On January 6th 2022 Construction Trade Technologies (Pvt) Ltd. signed a collaborative agreement with the Young Constructors’ Forum (YCF) to make Stockpile the method of choice for procuring construction materials by their member companies for a minimum period of two years.The members of the YCF have provided valuable feedback throughout the design and development phases to make Stockpile user-friendly and customized to address the needs of the Sri Lankan construction industry.Construction material procurement is a tedious process susceptible to many errors and is widely considered inefficient due to the ad-hoc nature of project-based procurement. The process of obtaining technical data for the purpose of project approvals take on average five communication attempts in Sri Lanka, mainly due to the lack of preparation on the part of suppliers and manufacturers. Stockpile aims to eliminate these inefficiencies by standardizing the requirements and collating the data for each product. Furthermore; procurement teams can request quotations, negotiate and submit purchase orders directly to the suppliers, thereby streamlining the entire procurement process.The commitment by the YCF to use Stockpile provides the suppliers on Stockpile the assurance that they will receive the purchasing requirements of the member companies without requiring any additional effort on their part.The Young Constructors Forum was founded on Feb 1st 2011 and consists of representatives of all leading construction firms in Sri Lanka.The member companies of the YCF include:
  • Consulting Engineers & Contractors (Pvt) Ltd.
